in_arabic.name: هيال

in_urdu.name: حیال

historical_references.reference: Ibn al-Qayyim mentions a man named Hayal ibn Yahya al-Juhani in his book 'I'lam al-Muwaqqi'in', who was a famous ascetic and Sufi scholar from Juhana in the Hejaz. He died around 639 AH (1242 AD).

Al-Maqrizi, in his work 'Al-Khitat al-Masriyah fi Ahwal Muluk Misr', mentions a man named Hayal ibn Khalaf al-Qushayri, who was the chief judge of Egypt under Sultan Qutuz. He died around 667 AH (1269 AD).
